steps.ask: How does categorical data differ from data that is counted or measured?
steps.title: Recall what categorical means

lines.text: Categorical data is sorted into groups, not counted or measured. It is ordinal if the groups have a natural order and nominal if they do not.

steps.ask: For each variable, is it sorted into groups, and if so, do the groups have a natural order?

lines.text: Size of coffee: categorical ordinal (small, medium, large have an order).

Number of sugars: numerical discrete. Time taken: numerical continuous.
